tool_args.rationale: The pilot shows sink-gradient dependence and possible endogenous adaptation, while its horizons are far shorter than the target. The slow-horizon probe directly resolves the consequential extrapolation ambiguity.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit sink-coupled dual-horizon adaptation to the five pilot rows
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Five short-horizon observations do not reliably identify five parameters or the slow response at H = 21.1.
Fine short-horizon trajectories would be less directly informative about the long-horizon adaptation.
The short pilot cannot distinguish a static response from a slow horizon-dependent reversal.
